description: Structured filter over all 103,372 variants (not only the 40-car demo): fuel, body, drive layout, power/price range, model year, EV-only. Keyset-paginated; returns opaque variant_ids for get_specs_full / compare_full. Paid per call with x402 (USDC) — $0.005.

body.description: Body type slug, e.g. suv, hatchback, sedan

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, to continue it

drive.description: Drive layout, substring match — front, rear, all

ev.description: true = battery-electric variants only. Default: false

fuel.description: Fuel slug, e.g. electric, petrol, diesel, hybrid

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

year.description: Production year the generation covers, e.g. 2022

name: filter_catalogue

data.description: Matches in catalogue order; empty when nothing matches

battery_kwh.description: Traction battery capacity, kWh; null without one

display_name.description: Full variant name, localized when a translation exists

fuel_slug.description: Fuel type slug, e.g. electric, petrol

variant_id.description: Opaque variant id, e.g. v_1a2b3c4d. Pass it to get_specs_full or compare_full.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last one. Pass it as `cursor`.

title: Filter the full catalogue (paid)
